title: Grow-up rates of inhomogeneous semilinear heat equations in the critical dimension
summary: This paper concerns the grow-up rate of solutions to a semilinear heat equation in the unit ball with the exponential nonlinearity and an inhomogeneous term $f$. When $f=0$, it is known that the large-time behavior of a solution changes at the critical dimension $N=10$, and the grow-up phenomenon occurs for the case $N\ge 10$. For the inhomogeneous case with $N\ge 10$, the present author and a coauthor showed in [12] that the grow-up phenomenon disappears once $f$ exceeds a threshold.
